events.title: Comedy, Pizza and Shots – SHOWCASE FRIDAY
events.description:
This show is in English!
Find one of the longest running English speaking comedy clubs in Berlin – Prenzlauer Berg. Indulge in a fantastic evening with stand-up comedy, pizza and shots!
Comedians perform their tried and tested sets to make you laugh at the Showcase events every Friday and Saturday.
Doors open at 7 PM. You will be greeted by one of our fabulous door people who give you a little introduction to the club. Get your free shot at the bar. There is always a 2 for 1 drink special until 8 PM, so come early and mingle with like-minded people. At around 8.15 PM vegetarian and vegan pizza from one of Berlins most popular Italian restaurants will be served at your seat. The show starts at 9 PM. Cosmic Comedy Berlin has an intermission and usually ends around 11 PM.
The host: Dharmander Singh

events.title: The Hilarious Deep Amazing Berlin Comedy Show with Gilli Apter
events.description:
TICKETS

Gilli Apter is one of South Africa’s top comedians, featured on the Netflix show Only Jokes Allowed.

Her confident, unique style and observations about life will make you laugh too hard to realise you’re having a nervous breakdown.

This is a show about everything that’s on your mind – relationships, AI, ADHD, kids vs not-kids, the past, your future, all our decisions – good and bad, the mad things going on in your specific city, Gilli’s identity, politics, the politics of Gilli’s identity and who knows what else! Watch Gilli weave whatever and whoever is in the room, together with her personal story, to create a unique experience each and every night.

So get tickets, get off your phone and get some friends together for a hilarious, deep, amazing night of comedy in your city.

The Hilarious Deep Amazing Comedy Show has been performed to repeatedly sold out rooms in London, Amsterdam, Zurich, Frankfurt, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Johannesburg, Stockholm, Madrid and many more.

Gilli’s Netflix Special: https://bit.ly/Netflix_GilliApter

This is a 16+ event / strictly no children.

All sales are final. Purchase will be refunded in the event of cancellation or rescheduling.

The show may include appearances from special guest comedians

events.title: TURBOPAOLO – IL POLIZIOTTO DEL FORMAGGIO 2026
events.description:
Originally Paolo Sarmenghi, TURBOPAOLO is one of the most distinctive digital comedians of his generation, known for turning everyday irony into a unique and immediate language. Overthinking, marketing techniques, dreams of glory, ads, dolphins, and everything the internet can spark in our minds are just some of the recurring themes in his sketches — all shaped through his unmistakable perspective. His style is unpredictable and deeply connected to the way we observe the world today: a mental feed you can get lost in for hours, which in recent years has also found a new dimension on stage. After building a strong following online, TURBOPAOLO brought his comedy to live audiences with a stand-up show that preserves the same energy, now enhanced by a more direct and impactful connection with the crowd. In 2025, he embarked on an extensive tour across several European cities, as well as throughout Italy, selling out multiple dates and strengthening his bond with audiences beyond the screen. Today, he continues to expand his comedic universe from digital platforms to live performance, with a style that is both recognizable and constantly evolving.

 

Tickets: eventim.de

events.title: Mike Rice – Cruel Little Man
events.description:
Irish rising star Mike Rice makes his Melbourne debut with a rapid-fire hour of darkly twisted storytelling. The Kilkenny native talks about trying psychedelics with his brother, an entanglement with a Spanish sausage dog named Nino, and many other such rotten adventures.

Following a sold-out run at the 2025 Edinburgh Festival Fringe, appearances on Channel 4’s A Comedy Thing and as heard on his Guide To Parenting podcast with Vittorio Angelone, Mike Rice is set to win the hearts of audiences across Australia with a distinctive comedic voice that’s equal parts unfiltered, loose and dangerously charming.

events.title: Dan Docimo – Live in Berlin
events.description:
Dan Docimo (they/them) is a standup comic with cute hair and a unique, disarming style. Dan was listed as a comic to watch as part of Time Out’s 2025 Comics on the Rise. They are also a member of the Prime Time Cast at the Lincoln Lodge and producer-drummer of Dumb and Drummer. Their credits include performances at the Limestone Comedy Festival, 10,000 Laughs Festival, Altercation Comedy Festival, and Art Basel. Most recently, Dan opened for Louis C.K. at the Chicago Theatre during a three-night run. Dan loves bringing audiences to tears with their thoughtfully absurd musings. When Dan is not on stage, you can find them failing at their day job, growing mushrooms at home or catching lobsters at the grocery store. You can follow Dan on Instagram and TikTok.

events.title: Tereza Hossa – Live in Berlin
events.description:
Tereza Hossa ist Kabarettistin, Tierärztin und gottverdammte Lebefrau. 1995 geboren in Australien, wuchs sie dann dennoch in Tirol auf und ist seit 2013 wohnhaft in Wien. Seit 2014, begonnen als Slam Poetin, tourt sie bereits durch den gesamten deutschsprachigen Raum. Mit ihrem ersten Kabarett Solo Programm Abenteuer ist sie seit 2019 auf der Bühne zu sehen.

Während Hossa wöchentlich eine satirische Videokolumne bei derstandard.at betrieb, schreibt sie u.a. für die Tagespresse und Twitter. Als Podcasterin ist sie Teil des Sciene&Fun Podcast Axolotl & Co zusammen mit ihrem Bruder und zelebriert die Donnerstage als erfrischendsten Tag der Woche zusammen mit Autoren-Kollegin Katharina Reckers in ihrem Podcast Duschbier. Durch ihr Mitwirken hinter und ihrem Auftreten vor der Kamera als Teil der Caroline Kebekus Show ist sie durch das deutsche Fernsehen und Internet durchgestartet. Als ausgebildete Tierärztin wird in ihrer künstlerischen Arbeit nicht nur das Schlachten von Tieren, sondern auch das Schlachten des Patriarchats thematisiert. Ob tiefschwarze Satire oder beiläufiges Rektalisieren der eigenen Gefühle: Tereza Hossa ist unberechenbar. Mit ihr fährt man Tagada.

Tereza ist seit 2024 gemeinsam mit Robin König Host des ARD-Podcasts “Weird Animals”

© Foto: Jennifer Fasching

 

Tickets: Tickets for TEREZA HOSSA @ Cosmic Comedy Club | Berlin | Wed, Nov 25, | from €23.10
